truth_boundary: Derived private-randomness and strict-past information results for the Chapter1 guessing game, printed pp.1-2/PDF13-14, equations(1.1)/(1.2). Seven producer/interface proofs and one definition are not seven printed source statements or a new regret rate. This covers arbitrary measurable private tapes independent of the WHOLE target process and predictions in subordinate pre-reveal information. It does not prove that every stochastic kernel or completed/augmented information model has this representation. On a probability space, each target Y_t is measurable, identically distributed with Y_0, a.s. in[0,1], and the entire target family is jointly independent. The measurable private tape S is independent of the WHOLE infinite target process, not just each target separately. H_t is the comap sigma field generated by S and the strict-past tuple (Y_i)_{i<t}; H_s is contained in H_t for s<=t. A general prediction P_t is measurable in F_t contained in H_t and is a.s. feasible. The concrete policy pi_t(s,z) is jointly measurable and feasible for EVERY seed only when all past inputs are in[0,1]; no off-cube boundedness is assumed. Ambient measurability, square integrability and current-target independence are derived. B_T=min_{u in[0,1]} E[sum_{t<T}(u-Y_t)^2]=T Var(Y_0) is the minimum of expected FIXED loss, with comparator outside expectation. It is not the expected hindsight minimum. For the SAME stream and prefix, expected-fixed excess equals sum E[(P_t-E[Y_0])^2]>=0. All private randomness is integrated in the same probability law; no pathwise nonnegative excess claim follows. At Lean t=0, the past is empty but the private tape may be used. Source rounds1..T correspond to Lean0..T-1; T0 is a disclosed empty-prefix extension. Only finite-horizon identities and lower bounds are proved here; source asymptotic-success equivalence remains REQUIRED. No unknown-law upper learning rate, high-probability or almost-sure convergence assertion. Only this independent-private-tape/subordinate-information finite IID producer is supported by the current package.
